When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA or IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angles β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° shall be equal to or greater than 1.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red Class IA and IB retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence α of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3: 5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.8∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; 2.5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions.

requirements.text: Where the stripline method is used, the immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested as described in Annex 9 at a test level of 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
requirements.quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.

requirements.text: Where the TEM cell method is used, the immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested as described in Annex 9 at a test level of 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
requirements.quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.

requirements.text: Where the BCI method is used, the immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested as described in Annex 9 at a test level of 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
requirements.quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.

requirements.text: Where the ALSE method is used, the immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested as described in Annex 9 at the Table 2a test levels in over 90 per cent of the frequency band.

requirements.text: Where the reverberation chamber method is used, the immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested as described in Annex 9 at the Table 2a test levels in over 90 per cent of the frequency band.

requirements.text: Where the stripline method is used, the immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested as described in Annex 9 at a minimum test level of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
